name: Concrete Slab
desc: A worn cast slab running out to the horizon — sawcut control joints converging on the vanishing point, trowel swirl still in the float finish, a hairline crack net opening under load, oil soaked into the pour, and a hard raking wedge of light sweeping the whole floor.

wear.doc: cracks, stains, spalling and exposed aggregate

scale.doc: joint spacing + perspective spread of the slab

style.doc: poured: raw cold pour, trowel swirl, oil stains · wet: rain-slick — standing water, mirrored sheen, rings on the bass · terrazzo: polished chip matrix with brass divider strips and a gloss pool · blueprint: the slab as a construction survey — cyan sawcut grid and measured crack net on navy

act.doc: drift: steady scroll · haul: the floor lurches forward on every kick · settle: the slab almost stops, breathing very slowly

seed.doc: deterministic seed — same number, same piece
